instruction: Download the ticket for my flight to Cairo this weekend from gmail into the "~/documents/work" folder of my file system.
notes: Two apps (gmail, file_system) plus supervisor. Information gathering is a chain: search inbox threads with query 'Cairo' -> show thread to get the email id -> show email to get the attachment id. The selection rule (flight to Cairo, dated this weekend relative to 2023-05-18) is encoded as the static fact (ticket-attachment ...) and documented in bindings; distractor tickets are omitted for minimality. gmail.download_attachment needs both the gmail token and the file_system token, so file_system.login must precede it; download_to_file_path is the literal directory '~/documents/work' so the new file lands under that folder. The goal demands only the download (one new file, no attachment changes), and supervisor.complete_task (no answer) carries the ticket attachment and target path as record parameters so its precondition equals the task-specific goal.
